name: commune
description: Open source community platform built on the MERN stack

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api, web, realtime -c blue,green,yellow "npm run dev -w @commune/api" "npm run dev -w @commune/web" "npm run dev -w @commune/realtime"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @commune/api && npm run build -w @commune/web && npm run build -w @commune/realtime
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @commune/shared && npm run typecheck -w @commune/api && npm run typecheck -w @commune/web && npm run typecheck -w @commune/realtime
scripts.test: npm run test -w @commune/api && npm run test -w @commune/realtime
